problem_text:
A shipping company must allocate cargo space for 7 distinct categories of freight, each requiring passage through 7 sequential handling stages at a port terminal.  
The revenue generated per metric ton for each freight category is as follows:  
* For Category Alpha, revenue is 13.986 per metric ton  
* For Category Beta, revenue is 10.991 per metric ton  
* For Category Gamma, revenue is 13.404 per metric ton  
* For Category Delta, revenue is 15.55 per metric ton  
* For Category Epsilon, revenue is 11.1 per metric ton  
* For Category Zeta, revenue is 18.381 per metric ton  
* For Category Eta, revenue is 19.336 per metric ton  

The terminal handling duration, expressed in metric ton-hours, required per unit for each stage is detailed below:  
* For Category Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.973, Stage 2 consumes 0.299, Stage 3 consumes 1.706, Stage 4 consumes 1.781, Stage 5 consumes 0.462, Stage 6 consumes 1.895, Stage 7 consumes 0.429  
* For Category Beta, Stage 1 consumes 0.573, Stage 2 consumes 1.92, Stage 3 consumes 1.695, Stage 4 consumes 1.238, Stage 5 consumes 0.718, Stage 6 consumes 0.655, Stage 7 consumes 0.926  
* For Category Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.216, Stage 2 consumes 1.345, Stage 3 consumes 0.293, Stage 4 consumes 1.593, Stage 5 consumes 0.326, Stage 6 consumes 0.218, Stage 7 consumes 0.712  
* For Category Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.591, Stage 2 consumes 1.699, Stage 3 consumes 1.113, Stage 4 consumes 1.889, Stage 5 consumes 0.406, Stage 6 consumes 0.798, Stage 7 consumes 1.533  
* For Category Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 0.782, Stage 2 consumes 0.462, Stage 3 consumes 1.241, Stage 4 consumes 0.313, Stage 5 consumes 0.871, Stage 6 consumes 0.657, Stage 7 consumes 0.797  
* For Category Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.073, Stage 2 consumes 1.164, Stage 3 consumes 0.352, Stage 4 consumes 0.768, Stage 5 consumes 0.891, Stage 6 consumes 0.926, Stage 7 consumes 1.064  
* For Category Eta, Stage 1 consumes 0.967, Stage 2 consumes 0.333, Stage 3 consumes 0.595, Stage 4 consumes 1.36, Stage 5 consumes 1.692, Stage 6 consumes 1.121, Stage 7 consumes 0.467  

The terminal’s daily operational capacity, measured in total available hours per stage, imposes the following ceilings:  
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 1 cannot surpass 77.03 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 2 cannot surpass 94.872 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 3 cannot surpass 65.265 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 4 cannot surpass 105.77 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 5 cannot surpass 61.023 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 6 cannot surpass 67.456 hours  
* The cumulative handling time for Stage 7 cannot surpass 70.4 hours  

Given the necessity to respect each stage’s hourly capacity limit, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for every freight category so as to maximize the terminal’s total daily revenue.
